tools.name: get_certificate_verification_info
tools.description: Explain how an employer can verify a moldtraining.us certificate of completion, and where to do it.

tools.name: get_price_quote
tools.description: Calculate the price for a number of seats in one moldtraining.us course, including the automatic bulk seat discount.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List all training courses offered on moldtraining.us with length, price per seat, audience, topics covered, and page URL.

tools.name: recommend_course
tools.description: Recommend the right mold course for a person based on what they do on the job. Use this when someone asks which course they need.

role.description: general_staff = general employee who needs to recognize mold and know when to escalate; property_management = property manager, maintenance technician, or leasing team member; inspector = mold inspector or remediation professional.

tools.name: search_site_content
tools.description: Search moldtraining.us content (FAQ answers, course curriculum, credential details, policies) and return the most relevant sections.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "moisture meter" or "refund policy".

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Open the moldtraining.us checkout page with a course and seat count selected. The person must enter their own billing and card details and click Pay; this tool never submits a payment.
